tickets.title: Access proxy sessions drop after a workday
tickets.description: Several people were signed out of the access proxy in the middle of the afternoon and had to repeat the device-posture check.

comments.author: amira
comments.text: Working as designed: access proxy sessions expire after 8 hours and then require a fresh device-posture check. Added a note to the VPN replacement guide.

tickets.title: Remote access sessions expire too early
tickets.description: Remote access keeps asking me to sign in again during the afternoon.

tickets.title: Session store evicts keys under memory pressure
tickets.description: Login latency spiked twice this week. The auth-gateway session store evicted live sessions when memory was tight, so users were asked to sign in again.

comments.author: amira
comments.text: Root cause: the eviction policy removed live sessions first. Switched to evicting only keys with an expiry and raised the memory limit.

comments.author: amira
comments.text: Login p95 is back under 400 ms. Closing.

tickets.title: Renew edge certificates earlier
tickets.description: Two edge certificates were renewed late because the renewal job ran during a deploy freeze. We want more margin before expiry.

comments.author: amira
comments.text: Proposal agreed in the platform sync: public certificates should rotate automatically 21 days before expiry instead of waiting for the old window. The runbook still needs updating.

tickets.title: Staging environment reset keeps failing
tickets.description: The weekly staging reset fails when the data refresh job is still running. Developers lose their test data on the next deploy.

comments.author: ravi
comments.text: Reproduced. The reset should wait for the refresh job; patch is in review.
